notes.title: Main Event: Wrestling Manager Returns to Development 👊
notes.content: [p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]First of all, I want to apologise for the silence over the past few months. There’s been a lot going on behind the scenes, and I feel it’s only fair to keep you all in the loop.[/p][p][/p][p]To be completely open, the last few months have brought a fair share of personal challenges. I’ve been dealing with ADHD and burnout, as well as the ups and downs that come with being a dad to a two year old (she’s got a better dropkick than half the roster, by the way). On top of that, I focused on the wrong areas of the game for a while, which ultimately slowed everything down, and we suffered a major setback when the original game files were lost due to a corrupt backup.[/p][p][/p][p]But here’s the good news: Main Event: Wrestling Manager is [b]officially back in development[/b]. As a one-man team, I’m developing this game in my spare time from South Wales, fitting it in around family and everything else life throws my way. Progress will be slow, but I hope you’ll bear with me.[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve decided to take a completely new approach. The game is being rebuilt from the ground up, and my priority now is on solid foundations; making sure the core systems are robust, user-friendly, and optimised. The lesson here: [b]make it work, then make it pretty.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This will mean some changes, but I’m confident it’ll result in a better experience for everyone in the long run. I’ve learned a lot about game development and project management during this break, and I’m putting it all into practice as we move forward.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience, your support, and your understanding. It means more than you know. I hope you’ll stick with me for the next stage of this journey. There’s plenty more to come, and I can’t wait to share it with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]James[/p]

notes.title: Patreon Goal #2: Mods & Steam Workshop
notes.content:
[h1]Bring your mods to the Steam Workshop[/h1]

Whilst developing this game and looking at community content, there's two things we knew for certain; 

[olist]
[*]A Wrestling booking simulator [b]thrives[/b] on user generated content.
[*]The Steam workshop is the #1 community hub for user generated content on earth.
[/olist]

So this is why we see it [b]absolutely necessary[/b] to make creating, sharing and using community content as easy as possible by integrating directly with the Steam Workshop.

Now, whilst this is something we could do ourselves, custom coding a full workshop mod system in-game is famously time-consuming and difficult. This is why we intend on using an industry-known service provider to handle the heavy lifting for us.

Along with full Steam Workshop integration, the provider makes it extremely easy for us to implement and use the Steam leaderboards, inventory, achievements, and more with the greatest of ease.

With that being said, we need your support in helping us achieve this goal. We currently need to raise just £150.00 in order to get this service up and running. You can help us hit this goal by supporting our [url=https://www.patreon.com/maineventgame]Patreon by clicking here[/url].

A list of benefits are available to any supporters, including discounted early access, merchandise, and the ability to be featured in the game!

Thanks for reading! 👊
James
